findings.title: Verify 字源 scan finding for 65E5
findings.details: [SCAN VERIFICATION REQUIRED] 字源, PDF p. 612 / printed p. 599, Shuowen quotation span “从口、一”: the printed enclosure appears 口-shaped, while other consulted transcriptions read 从囗一. The scan was inspected, but its pixels do not settle whether the intended printed graph is 口 or 囗; retain this occurrence as unresolved rather than normalizing it.
findings.verification: Check the identified printed page and exact scan span; correct source-bound OCR or record an unresolved glyph identity.
